text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I am the prince of this kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Luxurious parties continue day and night
within
my castle. These events are the
height of
extravagance and see me fed
with only the most
lavish of meals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I am dissatisfied with this
lifestyle. Is
there nothing that can help
me break free from
this dreary
monotony?
BAM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, one of the castle's outer
walls
crumbles! The dust clears to reveal
a lone girl
standing atop the debris!

I've finally arrived at the kingdom's
castle! My, it's
so brilliant and dazzling
and beautiful!

This is a castle truly fit for one such as
myself!

Oh my! I take it that you're the prince?
Oh, how
I've yearned to meet you! You
are quite literally
the prince of my
dreams!
Allow me to introduce myself. I am the one and only...

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Cinderella!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella's Stepmother
text_block_list.text:
C-Cinderella?! What are you doing
here?!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella's Stepsister
text_block_list.text: But we left you behind at the manor!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: I ran a hundred kilometers to get here!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
I climbed mountains, leapt across
valleys,
shattered boulders, swam
through raging rapids...

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
And after overcoming a series of
misfortunes, I've
finally arrived at the
party I've long awaited!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still don't quite understand what's
going on, but
this girl seems pretty
amazing.
Wheeze... Wheeze... H-hey! Cinderella! Wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Oh? Who might you be?
Pant... Phew... H-hang on a second... I need some water... We had to run all this way, too, you know?
Gulp, gulp... Ahhh! Okay! Prepare to have your mind blown, Cinderella! For I am...

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text: The Sorceress!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wait, did this "sorceress" also run a
hundred
kilometers to get here?!
That's... not all! Wheeze... Huff... There's me—wheeze—and...

text_block_list.name: Vodka the Fairy
text_block_list.text: M-me, the sorceress's... wheeze, wheeze... fairies! Pant... Phew!

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text:
Cinderella! You came all this way on
your own?
And just when I was about to
assist you with my
wondrous magic!

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text:
I guess you won't be needing that
pumpkin
carriage. Or a magical device
to help you cross
those treacherous
mountains. Hmm... What's left
that you
need?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet the Fairy
text_block_list.text:
Sorceress! I think she could use an
elegant dress
befitting this lavish party!

text_block_list.name: Vodka the Fairy
text_block_list.text: Wrong, Scarlet! What she needs is a pair of glass slippers! Some really sweet and stylish ones!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet the Fairy
text_block_list.text: Oh, what do you know?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka the Fairy
text_block_list.text: Say what?!

text_block_list.name: The Two Fairies
text_block_list.text: Do not!
choice_data_list_en: You two really get along, huh.
You two really get along, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, my prince? A
beautiful dress
or glass slippers, which
should I choose?

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?! You mean you don't want
either?!
choice_data_list: 君はそのままで素晴らしいよ
貴方はそのままで素晴らしいよ
もっと長所を伸ばそう！
choice_data_list_en: You're wonderful just the way you are.
You're wonderful just the way you are.
Let's build on your strengths even more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True beauty has nothing to do with your

appearance. I tell Cinderella what really
counts is
your heart and how you show
it.

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
I see! It's just like my beloved Princess
Fighter
said! "You shouldn't judge
people based on how
they look!"

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: So, basically... what you're saying is that I'm already a princess, right?!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I'm as princess as can be!
choice_data_list: そう！君こそがプリンセスだ！
そう！貴方こそがプリンセスだよ！

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Then what did we come all this
way for?! I
don't get you people!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Huh?! My strong points?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She ran a hundred kilometers over
perilous
terrain. That kind of powerful
physical ability is
remarkable. She has
limitless potential!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Me? An athlete?!
choice_data_list: 俺とアスリートの道を目指さないか！？
私とアスリートの道を目指さない！？
choice_data_list_en: Won't you aim for the path of an athlete with me?!
Why not strive to be an athlete with me?!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
Th-then... the thing I should ask the
sorceress for
is...

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: A pair of training shoes!

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text:
Come ooon, you don't need magic to
get training
shoes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep-beep-beep! Beep-beep-beep!
